name: Multi-Select Checkboxes
summary: Select several values from a list using an array of unique strings and `format: checkbox`
whenToUse: Requirements that say Control: Multi-select, checkboxes, or choose all that apply
Selecting several ADSP services, factors, or capabilities from a fixed list
When Maximum selections is specified (use maxItems)

uiSchema.label: Which services does your team currently use?

notes: Data type is `array` with `uniqueItems: true` — a string enum with format checkbox is single-select styling, not multi-select
Set `options.format` to `"checkbox"` so the array of enum values renders as checkboxes
Use `maxItems` when the document specifies Maximum selections; omit maxItems when any number of choices is allowed
Use `minItems: 1` when the multi-select itself is required
If an option is Other and a follow-up specify field is needed, SHOW that field with a rule condition `contains: { const: "Other" }`
